name: plugin.omarchy_command_router
description: Introspects and queries Omarchy Quattro's 455 modular CLI commands, routing architecture, and metadata headers.

entrypoints.name: omarchy_list_commands
entrypoints.description: List Omarchy CLI commands filtered by functional group and visibility

entrypoints.name: omarchy_get_command
entrypoints.description: Retrieve detailed metadata for a specific Omarchy CLI command

parameters.name: command_name
parameters.description: Name of command (with or without 'omarchy-' prefix, e.g., 'omarchy-theme-set' or 'theme-set')

entrypoints.name: omarchy_search_commands
entrypoints.description: Search Omarchy commands across names, summaries, usage patterns, and argument descriptions

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Keywords or search term to look up across command names, summaries, and help

entrypoints.name: omarchy_list_groups
entrypoints.description: List all functional command groups and their member command counts
